facts.fact: Trading window closed from 1-Oct-2026 until 48 hours after Q2FY27 results.
Cabinet approved rabi 2026-27 NBS rates (1-Oct-2026 to 31-Mar-2027): ~₹62,370 cr, ~64% above the previous rabi; DAP MRP held at ₹1,350 a bag.
Q2FY27 (Sep-2026 quarter) consolidated revenue ₹10,294 cr (+7%), EBITDA ₹942 cr, net profit ₹523 cr (vs ₹793 cr); results call 12-Nov-2026.
Report (unverified by the publisher) that management raised its FY27 EBITDA-margin outlook to 13.5% and expects a stronger H2.
Motilal Oswal maintained Buy, target cut to ₹2,400.
Elara Capital upgraded to Buy, target ₹2,490, lifting FY27 EBITDA 34% on the higher rabi subsidy.
Sep-2026 shareholding: promoters 56.34%, FIIs 11.34%, DIIs 20.48%, public 11.69%; shareholders 121,345.
